item.hero_bones.note: Sir Garran's scorched crossed bones with the nicked steel buckle his squire recognizes

item.knockers.note: bawa'iganaakoog (2026-10-08): a pair of light cedar ricing sticks

item.pail.note: akik (2026-10-08): a tin pail with a wire handle; what is in it shows at the top
